summaries.Romania: Romania faces political instability as PNL votes to support the PSD-led Niculescu government despite entering opposition, while healthcare budget cuts threaten emergency services and critical infrastructure projects face delays. Security concerns intensify with Russian drone incursions over the Black Sea and NATO coordination efforts.
summaries.Healthcare: AI is reshaping clinical workflows and administrative burden, with systems now assisting in prior authorization and patient consultations, while affordability remains the defining voting issue for Americans who increasingly seek government intervention over market solutions. Healthcare consolidation accelerates with major M&A activity and expanded benefit programs.
summaries.Tech: Apple's iPhone Duo launches Friday with inventory constraints, while AI agents face web restrictions and major platforms like Meta and TikTok navigate content policies around AI training and controversial documentaries. Innovation continues across smart home devices, wearables, and autonomous systems.

items.title: Three-quarters of Americans disillusioned with costs, say healthcare is defining voting issue
